style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, cute satire with comic horror
motion_rule: EVERY second something big crosses or fills the lens. Nothing comes to rest: the tags never settle, each slams onto her and springs off again while the coat builds; the goat crosses the lens three times
camera_moves: wide; close-ups are brought by the animals and the flying tags, not the camera
character: a fluffy white alpaca, long neck, absurd fringe, buck teeth, huge expressive eyes, stand-up comic energy
cast: the GOAT: grey-brown, big horns, square yellow pupils, an open fan of paper coupons and a pan flute he never stops playing; he gallops close past the lens
props: TAGS: price tags with butterfly wings, each a different bright colour — scarlet, lime, turquoise, gold — with a big embossed currency sign, no words. COUPONS: a paper fan. FLOWERS: white and yellow, the tags lift off them
prop_continuity: bright butterflies until 7.7; then each turns into a PIRANHA — wings stay, the body swells into a goggle-eyed fish head with small sharp teeth; from 8.6 they stay bitten into her coat
environment: sunlit Swiss alpine meadow, flowers, snowy peaks behind
lighting: blazing alpine noon, hard sun, crisp shadows; the horror is in the teeth

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: bright confident female voice, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.8-3.35 is ONE unbroken phrase, no break at 1.95 or 2.65; 5.0-7.0 is ONE unbroken phrase, the words run across the 5.9 boundary; voiceless after 7.0
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a light fairground pan flute all clip, paper wings, wind in the grass, a sharp CLICK at 8.6, then the flute alone

timeline.a: silent. She gallops at the lens until her muzzle fills the frame and a hoof slams her chest in a solemn vow
she rocks her whole body at the lens while the GOAT gallops in from the right, huge and close, his coupon fan swinging
no break. The fan sweeps right across the lens and blanks the frame
no break. She throws her head up and swings around after him, her flank wiping the frame
silent. The meadow erupts: a swarm of BRIGHT tags lifts off the flowers into the lens, blanking it twice, wings beating
one scarlet tag lands flat on the lens, covers the whole frame, then flutters off her nose as she rears up on her hind legs

no break, the phrase runs on. The swarm rams her from three sides at once, every tag slapping onto her and springing off again, the coat building out of pure churn; the goat gallops between her and the lens and blanks it
silent. She spins on the spot inside the coat, tags streaming off her flanks and hauled back in, one gold tag beating at the camera
silent. Every tag turns at once: bodies swell into goggle-eyed PIRANHA heads, jaws opening, the whole coat churning like a wave
silent. CLICK: every piranha bites at once; she jolts up on all fours and the coloured swarm bursts outward and blanks the lens
silent. Her eyes blow wide in comic horror, the grin frozen, the last piranhas raining past the lens

must_appear: bright multicoloured butterfly tags, the fan of coupons crossing the lens, tags covering her like a coat, every tag turning into a goggle-eyed piranha with teeth, her eyes wide in comic horror
negative_prompt: letters, words, cyrillic, readable text, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, dim light, people, hands, live insects, blood, a second alpaca, slow motion, the alpaca standing still, a motionless coat of tags, tags coming to rest on her, a talking head with an empty frame, accented Russian
